question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**efficiencies**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the rise of businesses seeking fresh perspectives and innovative ideas to improve projects.
 
• The appropriate noun should indicate the improvement of effectiveness and productivity in existing projects.
 
• "**Efficiencies**" fits well as it refers to improved effectiveness and productivity, which aligns with the context of optimizing existing projects.
 
• Other options ("**effecting**", "**effortless**", "**efficient**") do not adequately convey the idea of improving processes or outcomes within the projects.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Efficient (कुशल):** "Efficient" refers to effectiveness, but it does not fit as well as "efficiencies" in the context of improving the outcomes of projects.
 
• **Effortless (बिना प्रयास के):** "Effortless" means requiring little or no effort, which does not align with improving processes or outcomes.
 
• **Effecting (लाना):** "Effecting" means bringing about a change, but it doesn't convey the improvement of ongoing processes in the way "efficiencies" does.
